notes: Explore Crownreach: a 23.04 km-wide city covering about 205 square miles, with 400,000 residents represented by bounded district simulation. Visit Lantern Square, twelve districts and addressable buildings. Buy a village cottage, town apartment, suburban home, city apartment, penthouse or warehouse using your existing credits. Physical interiors offer private storage and home respawning. Courier, maintenance, produce and depot-restocking work moves finite goods and pays funded wages. Transit, contextual menus and a city guide connect the city to the existing towns. Nearby building batches, collisions and street actors stream within fixed budgets. Install the full 0.8.0 package for multiplayer protocol 15; bootstrap 3 is retained. Existing local saves, shared town ownership and player inventories are preserved.
